name: MUIIND
recent: MUIIND 于 2025 年 11 月 18 日召开 EGM，股东批准以 RM260.00 million 现金出售 Corus Hotel KLCC 予 Mah Sing Group 旗下公司；11 月 19 日公告买卖协议条件已全部满足，协议成为无条件。公司另于 10 月 29 日发出第 55 届 AGM 通知，将于 2026 年 12 月 10 日举行。
notable: 股东在 EGM 批准以 RM260.00 million 现金出售 Corus Hotel KLCC 予 Mah Sing Group 间接全资子公司。
买卖协议的所有先决条件于 2025 年 11 月 18 日满足，协议成为无条件。
公司将于 2026 年 12 月 10 日举行第 55 届常年股东大会。

Statement to Shareholders in relation to the proposed renewal of authority for the purchase of own shares by Malayan United Industries Berhad

recent_en: MUIIND held an EGM on 18 November 2025 where shareholders approved the disposal of Corus Hotel KLCC to a Mah Sing Group subsidiary for RM260.00 million cash; on 19 November it announced all conditions precedent to the SPA were fulfilled and the agreement became unconditional. The company also issued notice of its 55th AGM on 29 October 2026, to be held on 10 December 2026.
notable_en: Shareholders at the EGM approved the disposal of Corus Hotel KLCC to an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Mah Sing Group for RM260.00 million cash.
All conditions precedent to the SPA were fulfilled on 18 November 2025, making the agreement unconditional.
